text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, Эйр Грув is unable to
take first
place. All the same, her
satisfied fans cheer her
performance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Добер, who had been struggling
with her
self-esteem, watches Air
Groove run and realizes
she wants to be
just like her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Feeling the gaze of the world upon her,
Air
Groove states clearly her intention to
give a
better performance at the Shuka
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
